requirement: R12 one shell-owned refresh subscription, injectable source, gap resync, stale visibility

seam.factory: ShellOptions.runtimeEventSourceFactory (src/app.ts) -> makeRefreshSubscriptions (src/refresh.ts). Default is a real EventSource in a browser and an inert source when EventSource is absent (happy-dom/server render). Tests inject a fake and assert the exact stream URL.
seam.owner: createShellApp installs exactly ONE persistent Subscription entry (refresh) on the application; routes have no subscription entry. Starting/stopping the shell twice is tested on the real mountShell entry.
seam.sourceModule: src/refresh.ts: RuntimeEventSourceLike/Factory, initialRuntimeRefreshState, refreshRevisionStream (Stream.callback + Effect.acquireRelease closes the source), makeRefreshSubscriptions.

ownershipProof: mountShell(container,{runtimeEventSourceFactory: fake}) -> one fake source active; dispose twice -> zero active and one close; second mount -> one active (peak 1), first stays closed; two starts do not leak.

resyncProof.mechanism: Message.RuntimeRevisionReceived({revision}) -> update.ts. lastAppliedRevision gates old revisions. After a baseline, revision > lastApplied+1 is a gap: update immediately returns a RefreshSnapshot Command (token/routeId) and sets status='stale'. The Command runs without waiting for another event. resyncToken fences older resync results.
resyncProof.hardCase: revision 1 -> 3 with NO revision 2 and NO later event: snapshot reader is invoked once, page shows stale, then live on resolve; revision 2 arriving after 3 (while pending and after resolve) is ignored and does not re-trigger.
resyncProof.defaultSnapshot: Default RefreshSnapshot reader re-reads the diagnostics snapshot for the current diagnostics route; other routes have no client snapshot source and need an injected reader (recorded limitation).

staleVisibility: Model.refresh.status is rendered on the shell root (data-refresh-state/refresh-revision) and as a role=status stale banner. Pending shows 'Stale: resyncing after a revision gap.'; failure shows 'Stale: snapshot unavailable.' Tested both.

redGreen.injectable: .recursive/run/115-effect-foldkit-runtime-migration/evidence/logs/s25b-red-injectable.log (shell ignored the injected factory: no source)
redGreen.ownership: .recursive/run/115-effect-foldkit-runtime-migration/evidence/logs/s25b-red-ownership.log (subscription opened a duplicate source: expected 1, got 2)

testRuns.command: vitest s25b + mount + routes + diagnostics + diagnostics-client + diagnostics-e2e
testRuns.biome: biome check src + new test: exit 0

unproven: A real browser EventSource network reconnect; non-diagnostics routes have no production snapshot reader (injected reader required); no generic runtime snapshot endpoint exists in this client.
